name: Visual-row bounded editable prepaint

atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.

hypothesisMarkdown:
# Hypothesis

The layout map's sorted logical rows carry `visual_start` and `visual_len`, so prepaint can find
the logical rows intersecting the viewport plus one visual-row overscan with two partition-point
searches. Iterating only that contiguous range removes the all-logical-row scan and per-row cull
from steady scrolling.

## Scope lock

This experiment adds only a visual-row-to-logical-row range query and uses it in prepaint. It does
not change layout creation, cache reuse, edit invalidation, selection geometry, or paint order.
measurementPlanMarkdown:
# Measurement plan

Run the isolated headed WASM/WebGPU TextArea wheel fixture at DPR 1 and 2 with five warmups and
thirty measured samples, inspect the DPR 2 screenshot, and retain raw timing artifacts. Source
inspection must prove steady prepaint uses a bounded range rather than `0..logical_row_count`.
expectedOutcomeMarkdown:
# Expected outcome

The scrolled large TextArea paints the same visible text and retains its cursor and selection
semantics. Prepaint visits only rows overlapping the viewport, with one visual row of overscan on
each side.

measurements.target: headed WASM WebGPU TextArea wheel action
measurements.protocol: One page-isolated 35-run Playwright process per DPR with five warmups and thirty measured samples.

reportMarkdown:
# Visual-row bounded editable prepaint

All 70 focused headed WASM/WebGPU samples passed. The DPR 2 screenshot shows the expected
scrolled populated TextArea. Prepaint now uses two partition-point searches over sorted row
metadata and paints only viewport-intersecting rows plus one visual row of overscan.

| DPR | Baseline p50/p95 | After p50/p95 | Reduction p50/p95 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 534.002 / 593.299 ms | 112.869 / 116.588 ms | 78.9% / 80.4% |
| 2 | 497.957 / 561.084 ms | 112.852 / 124.215 ms | 77.3% / 77.9% |

Accept the result: both cells meet the epic TextArea threshold of 25% of baseline.
decisionMarkdown:
# Decision

Accept visual-row bounded prepaint. It removes the all-logical-row culling scan, preserves visible
output, and materially improves the fixed WASM interaction measurement at both DPRs.
